Question B-007-006-002.

Why the correct answer is right: MUF varies as solar radiation changes ionization along the path. Time of day, season, and solar activity all affect that radiation input.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "The temperature of the ionosphere": The temperature of the ionosphere is not the main control of MUF; electron density from ionization is the key.
- sourceIndex 2: "The speed of the winds in the upper atmosphere": The speed of the winds in the upper atmosphere can move irregularities, but it is not the basic cause of MUF variation.
- sourceIndex 3: "The type of weather just below the ionosphere": The type of weather just below the ionosphere belongs to the troposphere and does not set HF MUF.
